description: This file is a CMake module script defining a function `compile_aidl` that automates the generation of source code from AIDL files during build time. It includes detailed comments, usage instructions, and the implementation of the `compile_aidl` function with parameters for configuring the aidl compilation process.

methods.name: compile_aidl
methods.description: Defines a CMake function to compile AIDL files into source code with configurable options such as language, include directories, target directory, and specific aidl binary.
